description: Search-budget fix check (2026-10-25): every permission question plus the expanded multi-hop slice and q028. Not a baseline.

questions.query: How long do we have to respond to a customer data access request?
What is the band minimum and maximum annual base salary for level L5?
questions.note: salary bands live in hr/salary-bands.md (dept [hr]); engineer must get zero hits. Query wording matches the band table so the document would rank if the asker were allowed, which is what makes this a live ACL test

questions.query: How much severance does the CEO get if terminated without cause?
questions.note: executive/severance-policy.md is private [executive]; HR is denied

questions.query: What do non-employee directors get paid per board meeting?
questions.note: board calendar is private [executive]; finance analyst is denied

questions.query: What is the smallest deal size that needs the board's approval?
questions.note: M&A policy is private [executive]; sales rep is denied

questions.query: What commission rate does a rep earn on new business?
questions.note: commission plan is role [sales_manager, director]; support agent is denied

questions.query: What is the monthly spending limit on a VP's corporate card?
questions.note: corporate card policy is role [manager, director, finance_manager]; HR generalist is denied

questions.query: What is the CSAT target in the agent scorecard?
questions.note: scorecard is role [support_manager, director]; a regular agent is denied

questions.query: How fast must a critical vulnerability be patched?
questions.note: security/vulnerability policy is role [director, it_admin]; regular engineer is denied (contrast q044)

questions.query: What are the final pay rules for an employee being let go?
questions.note: termination policy is role [manager, hr_manager]; engineer is denied

questions.query: How are performance ratings calibrated across teams?
questions.note: performance review policy is role [manager, director, hr_manager]; support agent is denied

questions.query: What is PF-330 and who has to sign it?
questions.note: procurement forms guide is department [finance, operations]; a sales rep is denied

questions.query: What is DRP-11 and who can declare it activated?
questions.note: DR runbook is department [operations, engineering, executive]; support is denied (contrast q099)

questions.query: What does Clause 7.3(b) commit us to?
questions.note: DPA handbook is department [legal, sales, finance]; an engineer is denied (contrast q105)

questions.query: After a SEV-1, when is the postmortem due and how long must its incident records be retained?
questions.note: incident response supplies the postmortem deadline; log policy supplies seven-year retention

questions.query: An employee approved to work abroad is leaving the company. What remote-work condition applies and when must the laptop be returned?
questions.note: remote-work approval and equipment-return timing come from separate policies

questions.query: An employee wants to use their development budget for an overseas conference. What training approval and travel approval rules both apply?
questions.note: the purchase needs training approval and the trip needs travel approval

questions.query: A customer contract lets a vendor process personal data. When do Legal review and a data processing addendum become required?
expected_sections: When a Data Processing Addendum Is Required
questions.note: contract approval and data-processing terms are governed by separate legal documents

questions.query: A P0 response target was missed and the customer demands compensation above the standard SLA credit. What credit and complaint escalation rules apply?
questions.note: the SLA defines the credit; extra compensation follows the complaint path
